t: Time 3093Y white flexible cable delivers reliable performance for light duty indoor electrical applications. This 25m drum features a 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The heat-resistant PVC sheath withstands operating temperatures from -15 to 90°C, whilst 24 x strands per core ensure superior flexibility and durability for trade installations requiring dependable, hardwearing cable solutions.
